title: Celebrate Small Wins
story: People often overlook progress because they focus only on the final goal. But every completed step builds confidence and momentum. Small accomplishments deserve recognition. Reflection turns experience into wisdom. Without reflection, a moment passes; with reflection, it can reveal a pattern, clarify a value, or help us decide what to carry forward. The lasting importance is simple: recognizing progress helps create motivation for the next step.
impact: Recognizing progress helps create motivation for the next step. Reflection is not dwelling on the past; it is using experience to make the next choice with greater awareness. This matters because the lesson is transferable. It can help someone recognize a pattern, make a more thoughtful choice, or see possibility where they previously saw only a problem.
spark_application: What is something you accomplished that deserves more credit? Write one sentence about what this brings up for you, one lesson you want to remember, and one thing you are ready to do differently. Afterward, save a short note about what you noticed, what surprised you, or what you may want to revisit.
